MTEX2::process returns immediately unless leftExpander.module (+0xe8) has modelMegaTang as its model.

The four values it multiplies are the raw channel input voltages: MegaTang::process copies inputs 0 to 3 into the message before any level, pan or mute is applied. This second send is therefore pre-fade, unlike MEGA-TANG's own, which is taken after the level and the mute.

The sum is the only clamped output anywhere in the expander pair: it is limited to -10V and 10V.

All four knobs are configured 0 to 1 with a default of 0 and a display multiplier of 100.

No debug printf is reached through this expander; the printf pair belongs to MT-EX1 and to MEGA-TANG's MT-EX1 branch.
